name: DashCore Experimental Renderer
description: Experimental Android renderer foundation for Geometry Dash level objects. This diagnostic prerelease supports a low-overhead A/B baseline and optional per-level indexed object capture. The original Geometry Dash renderer remains the only visible draw path. No draw replacement or performance gain is claimed.

capture-object-diagnostics.name: Capture object diagnostics
capture-object-diagnostics.description: Enables per-frame read-only object and sprite capture for the A/B comparison. When disabled, DashCore only sends level lifecycle markers while Launcher Diagnostics measures the game. Changes apply from the next level.
